brief.zh: 写正解的商为 A+B√m，其中 A=muv−ab，B=bu−av。由范数一和商大于一得 A≥2、B≥1，再取有理坐标。旧题只处理 m=2。
brief.en: Write the quotient of the positive solutions as A+B√m with A=muv−ab and B=bu−av. Norm one and quotient greater than one give A≥2 and B≥1. Extract the rational coordinate. The earlier task covers m=2.
